Notes: vCenter FQDN, 9.0 or later. Script needs HTTPS access.
vCenter login (e.g. administrator@vsphere.local); SSO supported.
vSAN witness VM name or FQDN; used by vSAN-OSA/ESA.
ESX login. Omit to use default root.
Boolean. Default false when not defined (one password for all hosts). true = prompt per host.
Boolean. When true, uses VCENTER_COMMON_PASSWORD / ESX_COMMON_PASSWORD env vars.
Boolean. When true, some vSAN health checks are relaxed. With -Force, bypasses cleanup confirmation.
Existing vSphere datacenter; clusters are created under it.
Prefix for cluster names. Omit for default cluster; format {prefix}-{edgeSite}.
Prefix for datastore names. Omit for default datastore; format {prefix}-{edgeSite}.
Prefix for supervisor names. Omit for default supervisor; format {prefix}-{edgeSite}.
Prefix for VDS names. Omit for default VDS; format {prefix}-{edgeSite}.

When the key is present, datastore for supervisor content library (must already exist); script runs Initialize-SupervisorContentLibrary. When the key is omitted (removed) entirely, the content library workflow is skipped.
When supervisorContentLibraryDatastore key is present, subscription URL for the content library. If omitted, default is https://wp-content.vmware.com/supervisor/v1/latest/lib.json.
vLCM image name in vCenter Image Catalog; omit to choose at run time.

Optional. When defined, overrides the default MTU (9000) for the VDS and for vMotion/vSAN VMkernel adapters only. Mgmt (vmk0) and vSAN Witness (vmk3) are always 1500. Must be 1500-9190 (numbers only; validated at JSON load). Use 1500 when the physical path does not support jumbo frames.
Optional. Legacy. MTU (1500-9190) for VDS and vMotion/vSAN VMkernels when common.vSanvMotionVmKernelMtuValue is not set. Mgmt and vSAN Witness are always 1500.

Array of NICs for the VDS (e.g. [{"name":"vmnic1"},{"name":"vmnic2"}]). Number of uplinks = length of nicList. Required at common or per cluster (clusters[].nicList); cluster overrides common. Must have 2 or 4 NICs.
VCF context name used by VCF CLI for ArgoCD.
Array of cluster configurations. Each cluster is identified by edgeSite and contains ESX hosts, supervisor services, storage policy, and networking.
Unique site ID; must match one tkgsSiteSpec[].edgeSite in supervisor.json.
Optional override for this cluster. When present (2 or 4 NICs), overrides common.nicList. At least one of common.nicList or clusters[].nicList must be defined per cluster.
Array of ESX FQDNs or IPs; script needs HTTPS access to each host.
Path to ArgoCD operator YAML (escape backslashes on Windows).
Path to ArgoCD instance YAML; namespace in file must match nameSpacePrefix.
ArgoCD namespace prefix. Omit for default argocd; script appends cluster MoRef for uniqueness.
Array of VM class names for ArgoCD namespace. Omit to assign all VM classes from vCenter.
Tag catalog for storage policy. Omit for default {storageType}-Storage-TagCatalog.
Storage type: VMFS, vSAN-ESA, or vSAN-OSA.
The only valid value is Fully initialized. Do not change otherwise the script will error.
Array of segments; names must match supervisor.json network references.
Segment name; lower-case, RFC1123; must match supervisor.json.
VLAN ID (0-4095); unique within this cluster.
Gateway in CIDR (e.g. 10.30.10.1/24); mapped into supervisor by segment name.

Required for vSAN-ESA and vSAN-OSA only (not VMFS). At least two entries: vMotion, vSAN (required). Optional third: vSAN Witness. Each entry: service, vlanId (0-4095), netmask (valid IPv4 netmask), ipList (exactly two unique IPv4s, one per host). Only the vSAN Witness entry requires gateway.
